title: The beat position at a moment; graphics extrapolate from it

at.description: When the beat was there, in ms since 1970 (the extension's clock); 0 before the first reading.

epoch.description: Moves on at every jump (a seek, a new track).

locked.description: Whether the phase came from the lightshow (true) or is the extension's own, at the lightshow's tempo (false).
